# affectUI Segmented Control Clean

- Source: https://github.com/flohoeller/affectui/blob/c87280abc0aadb7da181756a734609fc112df87e/components/segmented-control-clean.tsx
- Reviewed revision: `c87280abc0aadb7da181756a734609fc112df87e`

- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

EduPi vendors this free component in `components/AffectSegmentedControl.tsx`. EduPi adds an attribution header, a reselect callback to preserve existing reminder/calendar behavior, and a stable option-identity dependency for dynamic task categories. The reminder, calendar, and workspace surfaces supply their existing values and callbacks and override color tokens to match the workbench.
